name: Random List Geometry Generator
definition: Generates a random set of k lines (rays) for a D-dimensional scanning volume. Origins are placed on the boundary of the volume, and directions are generated using Gaussian distributions to ensure spherical symmetry, then adjusted to point inward.
summary: The Random List Geometry Generator creates inward-pointing rays from volume boundaries, distinguishing itself by constraining origins to the boundary rather than sampling camera positions on a sphere.
